d.ko: Destroy endless waves of alien ships that have all but wiped out humanity in this long form, unfolding, sci-fi idle game.  Customize your ship with different weapons and defenses to defeat specific enemy types and utilize a ton of different systems to increase your overall power.

d.zh: 在这款长篇开放式放置游戏中消灭一波又一波几乎毁灭了人类文明的外星飞船。用不同的武器和防御模块定制你的飞船以击败各式敌人并利用大量独特的系统来增强你的力量。
